hebrewText: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵ/הוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי צֹ֜אן וּ/שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַ/חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד בָּקָר֙ וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת וַ/עֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יְהִי֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל מִ/כָּל בְּנֵי קֶֽדֶם

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition
tokens.kjv: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

tokens.bdb: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
tokens.kjv: ([phrase] by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare H7658 (שִׁבְעָנָה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanation: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: seven ; also  seven times; by implication

tokens.kjv: thousand.

tokens.enLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.kjv: [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

tokens.kjv: camel.

tokens.bdb: five
tokens.kjv: fif(-teen), fifth, five ([idiom] apiece).

tokens.kjv: acre, couple, [idiom] together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).

tokens.bdb: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
tokens.kjv: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.

tokens.bdb: a female donkey (from its docility)
tokens.kjv: (she) ass.

tokens.bdb: something wrought, i.e. (concretely) service
tokens.kjv: household, store of servants.

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
tokens.kjv: diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), [idiom] louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ([phrase] much, sore), well.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

tokens.bdb: the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward)
tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).
